title: CES AI Postcard Generator
summary: A prompt-driven postcard experience that turns a visitor’s choices into personalized AI-generated imagery.

details.focus: Generative interaction design and event engagement
details.tools: Tailwind · JavaScript · FLUX Generative AI · Prompt Matrix
details.problem: Most event touchpoints are forgettable. The challenge was to create a lightweight, memorable interaction that could turn a quick scan into a personalized creative artifact.
details.approach: I designed a short prompt flow that captures a visitor’s CES mindset and translates it into a generated postcard composition with a consistent visual frame.
details.outcome: The concept creates a flexible bridge between physical networking, mobile interaction, and generative media.

title: InTrust
summary: Local-first estate planning software that turns structured intake into carefully formatted legal document packages.

details.focus: Legal document automation and workflow design
details.problem: Estate packages are often assembled through repetitive manual drafting, formatting, and document coordination. The challenge was to preserve legal formatting precision while making the workflow faster and easier to repeat.
details.approach: I built a local-first desktop workflow that guides intake, applies rule-based logic, and generates formatted Word documents while respecting strict legal document conventions.
details.outcome: The result is a practical automation tool that reduces repetitive drafting effort and creates a foundation for bespoke firm-specific estate planning workflows.

title: Dell Foundation Digital Gallery
summary: An interactive, large-format gallery for exploring foundation stories through media, motion, and touch.

details.focus: Large-format web experience and content system
details.problem: The experience needed to organize rich media and story content for a large display environment without feeling like a conventional website.
details.approach: I built a fullscreen interactive gallery structure with cinematic tile behavior, modal content, video embeds, and layout logic suited for large-screen viewing.
details.outcome: The result was an immersive digital gallery prototype that made foundation stories easier to browse, present, and experience.

title: Dogwood Counseling Website
summary: A welcoming web presence for a Boulder therapist, built around clear services, trust, and easy contact.

details.focus: Client site design, trust-building, and light SEO
details.problem: The provider needed a web presence that felt calmer, more trustworthy, and more aligned with the emotional tone of therapy work.
details.approach: I focused on simple information architecture, warm visual language, clear service framing, and accessible contact pathways.
details.outcome: The site became a more polished and approachable digital front door for prospective clients.
